We design the frameworks, tools, and ways of working that help the broader team focus on its highest-impact priorities and execute them effectively.

Zudem hast Du Erfahrung im Umgang mit agilen Tools wie Jira und Confluence und bringst ein gutes Verständnis für Softwareentwicklungsprozesse sowie technische Zusammenhänge mit.

Remote, work from home opportunity.

• Work directly with SQL Server: write and optimize T-SQL, stored procedures, and SQL Server Agent jobs

• Contribute to execution of the platform's future migration to a modern web-based architecture, helping implement target architecture (e.g., ASP.NET Core/Blazor) under the guidance of senior engineers and BI leadership.

• Collaborate with BI, Analyst, Processing, and Submission team stakeholders to translate billing workflow requirements into robust technical solutions

• Leverage Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and code quality.

Qualifications

• Fluent English communication skills (C1 level or equivalent).

• 3-5 years of hands-on software development experience

• Hands-on experience with VB.NET & .NET Framework required; exposure to C#, ASP.NET Core, Blazor, or Entity Framework Core a plus

• Hands-on T-SQL and SQL Server experience - database design, query optimization, stored procedures, and SQL Server Agent job scheduling

• Experience developing and maintaining WinForms desktop applications , including MDI (multi-document interface) architecture

• Familiarity with Angular a plus

• Experience writing and maintaining automated tests (unit/functional/regression) in a .NET environment.

• Experience with Azure DevOps (Boards, Pipelines), GitHub and code-quality gating tools (e.g., SonarQube) is a plus

• Ability to design, estimate, and deliver well-defined software solutions from business requirements

• Understanding of financial systems, financial processes, and billing/invoicing terminology is highly desirable

• Eagerness to grow technical ownership over time, with mentorship and guidance from senior engineers on the team

• Experience with Claude Code or similar AI-assisted development tools is preferred

Who We Are
KLDiscovery provides technology-enabled services and software to help law firms, corporations, and government agencies solve complex data challenges. Our Nebula Ecosystem provides powerful end-to-end eDiscovery and enterprise-grade information governance. Through its global Ontrack data recovery business, KLDiscovery delivers world-class data recovery, disaster recovery, email extraction and restoration, data destruction, and tape management.

title: Platform Engineer (remote work)
description:
CloudLinux builds Linux infrastructure and security products. You will join our Automation & Management Services cell, working closely with Dmitrii Petrov to solve problems across teams and services: cloud-cost data, infrastructure inventory, network policies and capacity workflows.
Check out our website for more information
Inside the Infrastructure Department, the Platform cell is a small team. We run the observability platform, the company's GitLab and the CI runners behind it, a few smaller engineering services, and the automation the department relies on for provisioning and configuration.
We are looking for a Platform Engineer for the PaaS team to take ownership of an agreed set of platform services: keep them reliable and within agreed service levels, make changes and recovery repeatable, and reduce recurring operational work through automation and self-service.
You get real freedom in how you implement things, and you own the result: you pick the approach, defend it in review, and answer for how the service behaves afterwards.
Most of the job is what site reliability engineering is about: services that run well day after day, and requests from product teams handled properly. Some of it is building. The observability platform and the runner cluster were both built from scratch within the last year, and there will be more of that. Expect the work to split between platform engineering, incident response, and helping engineers in other teams use what we run.
What you'll do

•
Run the observability platform. Keep it healthy, onboard teams, watch cost and capacity, and maintain the alerting that runs on top of it.

•
Run GitLab and the CI runner fleet. Upgrades, capacity, access, backups and restore drills.

•
Keep the rest of our services healthy, with the monitoring and runbooks a production service needs.

•
Deploy new services when they are requested. Research the options, pick a design, and stand the service up from scratch according to good practice: as code, monitored, backed up, documented.

•
Work with developers' requests. Access, onboarding, pipeline problems, new exporters and dashboards. Answer them, and turn the recurring ones into self-service.

•
Run incidents. Diagnose and mitigate impact, restore service safely, then complete the root-cause analysis and post-mortem. Deliver the prevention or detection improvements the incident calls for.

•
Ship everything as code, reviewed in merge requests. Plan and check before every change.

•
Write for engineers outside the team. Runbooks, onboarding guides, maintenance notices and status updates that people can act on.

•
Work with AI agents. Delegate collection and drafting to them, review their output as you would a colleague's merge request, and record what you learn where the team can find it.

Requirements

Must have

• Senior-level experience in infrastructure, platform or site reliability engineering, including at least one production service you were responsible for keeping up. We will ask you to walk us through it in detail: what broke, how you found out, and what you changed so it would not happen again.

• Linux systems administration and debugging on bare metal and virtual machines. Much of our infrastructure is not Kubernetes.

• Kubernetes in production delivered through GitOps, including cluster upgrades you performed yourself.

• Infrastructure as code as your delivery form: Ansible and Terraform or OpenTofu, changes reviewed in merge requests.

• GitLab administration and GitLab CI in production, self-hosted or SaaS. Deep experience with another CI system is acceptable if you can show the same depth.

• Working knowledge of the Prometheus and Grafana ecosystem: you have run it for a team, written alert rules and dashboards, and can read PromQL. Depth here is welcome, and learnable.

• Written technical explanation for engineers outside your team: runbooks, notices, answers to requests.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills. This role deals

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
Application Security Engineer

Parallels is seeking a highly motivated and talented Application Security Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will make security decisions that impact millions of our customers while gaining hands-on experience in exploit development and CVE discovery. The ideal candidate will combine an attacker mindset with the humility and detail-oriented attitude required to coordinate fixes and security architecting with busy engineers.

Your primary responsibility will be to coordinate with more senior members of our team to write exploits and design fixes for existing application vulnerabilities. You will also help search for new critical/high risk vulnerabilities in our codebase. In addition, you will assist in vulnerability disclosure processes and help implement repeatable secure development practices.

As issues are uncovered, you will communicate with the appropriate technical and leadership teams to ensure a focus on risk mitigation - allowing for business continuity, but without negligent risk. Application security engineers are constantly assessing applications for weaknesses and finding resolutions before they can be abused.

Parallels : anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity.Why Parallels , why now?

The top creative and technical minds could sell anywhere. So why are so many choosing Parallels ? Three reasons:

This is the moment. It's an exciting time at Parallels - strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to how the world works. The EUC market is shifting fast, and we're at the front of that wave. We want you riding it with us.

We want you to be you. Too many companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Ours is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe being who you are, taking risks, and showing us what you've got.

It's your world. We know you have a life. We want to be part of it - not all of it. At Parallels , we're serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. Happy sellers mean happy customers. That's why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let's talk about the role

What you'll do:

• Reproduce and triage incoming vulnerabilities from security automation/bug bounty programs, then propose granular fixes to engineers

• Discover vulnerabilities and construct exploits for core Parallels applications such as Parallels Remote Application Server

As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.

We are looking for an Edge AI Engineer to design, optimize, and deploy machine learning models that run efficiently on resource-constrained edge devices, including mobile platforms, embedded systems, and specialized accelerators. • Drive responsible AI considerations including on-device privacy and bias evaluation.

• Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation - including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures - so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.

• Stay current with edge AI hardware and software developments, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.

As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

SUMMARY - ABOUT THE TEAM / JOB

Connected Warfare is the team at Anduril dedicated to the modernization of the command and control systems of U.S. and Allied forces. New technologies and new adversaries demand a new approach to battlefield intelligence, and our products are rapidly scaling in production to deliver the volumes that our customers need. In this role you’ll need to think creatively and come up with solutions to solve difficult testing problems and push to continuously improve our methods of automation, throughput, user interfaces, and data analytics. You will work in a team of mechanical, electrical, software and firmware engineers in the manufacturing floor to efficiently scale our products’ production.

The right person for this role has a high level of ownership and drive to improve their skills as a Manufacturing Test Engineer. If you are someone who isn’t afraid of taking on large scale and complex projects or getting outside of your comfort zone and learning about new and challenging concepts, then this role is for you.

description:
Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen.

Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen.

Die Rolle

In unserer Eigenproduktion bauen wir die Komponenten vor, die unsere Installationsteams beim Kunden direkt einsetzen: hydraulische Cubes und elektrische Unterverteilungen für die Wärmepumpe. Je besser sie vorgefertigt sind, desto schneller und sauberer läuft die Installation vor Ort.

Cubes sind unsere vormontierten Hydraulikmodule, die alle wesentlichen Komponenten für den Heizkreis kompakt in einem Gehäuse bündeln. Wir fertigen sie in mehreren Varianten für unterschiedliche Wärmepumpen und Einbausituationen.

Unterverteilungen sind die elektrischen Verteiler, über die die Wärmepumpe abgesichert und angeschlossen wird. Sie werden nach Plan in Standardvarianten je Geräteserie und Leistungsklasse aufgebaut.

Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Produktionsteam innerhalb von Supply Chain, eng verzahnt mit Lager, Kommissionierung und Einkauf. Die Produktion wächst mit unseren Installationszahlen und zieht 2027 in unser neues Hauptlager in Ludwigsfelde.

Deine Aufgaben

- Montage von Cubes: Rahmen aus Aluprofilen aufbauen, Komponenten einsetzen, Verrohrung in Edelstahl-Pressfitting und Gewinde herstellen, Verkleidung montieren.

- Aufbau und Verdrahtung von Unterverteilungen nach Bestückungsplan, Stückliste und Stromlaufplan, inklusive Beschriftung der Betriebsmittel.

- Qualitätsprüfung vor Auslieferung: Dichtheitsprüfung der Cubes, Sicht- und Funktionsprüfung der Unterverteilungen, Dokumentation der Prüfergebnisse.

- Vorbereitung von Material für die Produktion, z. B. Kabel ablängen, Anschlusssets zusammenstellen, Rohre zuschneiden.

- Übergabe fertiger Cubes und Unterverteilungen in die Projektkommissionierung, termingerecht zur geplanten Installation.

- Pflege der Materialbestände am Arbeitsplatz und frühzeitige Meldung von Fehlmengen an Lager und Einkauf.

- Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Varianten und Arbeitsabläufe: Rückmeldung aus der Montage zu Stücklisten, Bauteilen und Prozessen.

This is a remote role that calls directly on HCP offices in the assigned, specific geography to address questions about patient access & reimbursement. Provides expertise on coverage and reimbursement barriers to better enhance the patient experience and effectively navigate the complexities of the local healthcare landscape and overcome access barriers. Responsibilities include educating HCPs about access and reimbursement via AbbVie approved support tools, advising HCPs on patient prescription status, program eligibility, and educating offices on payer processes and procedures.

• Educate HCPs on patient support programs, including approved access and reimbursement through AbbVie support tools and services.

• Be a subject matter expert on relevant local, regional, and national payer policies to appropriately educate providers on payer requirements.

• Develop and sustain relationships with relevant providers within the territory. Utilize strong communication skills to facilitate clear, concise, and efficient information exchanges with Field Reimbursement Managers (FRMs), HCPs, and other stakeholders.

• Effectively work in a high cross-matrix environment, implementing appropriate ways of working communication with teams in sales, market access, patient service peers, to update HCPs on Rx status and program eligibility.

• Demonstrate agility to effectively incorporate the use of approved resources and data to appropriately support HCP education initiatives that enhance the patient’s experience.

• Identify and report back payer trends related for approved products to Patient Services and market access account management teams.

• Take ownership of process improvement initiatives, continuously seeking ways to enhance system efficiency and patient access strategies.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or Associate degree in fields such as biological sciences, pharmacy, business related field, or equivalent preferred.

• 3-5 years of experience in account management, payer account management, and/or access and reimbursement.

• Thorough understanding of payer policy processes, published criteria and documentation for coverage, coding, prior authorization, and appeal processes.

• Demonstrated understanding of the rules, regulations and risks associated with provision of reimbursement support services.

• Comprehensive understanding of commercial and governmental payer access dynamics

• Strong communicator with proven ability to navigate cross-matrix environments, ensuring clear, concise, and timely information exchange between internal and external stakeholders to drive alignment.

• Utilize critical thinking to assess and prioritize workloads at the account level, ensuring optimal resource allocation and seamless operations

Landmark, a Halliburton company, builds the software and data solutions that help the global energy industry make better decisions. These are tools used daily by engineers and scientists at the world’s largest energy companies and run as cloud-native SaaS and as enterprise on-premises solutions.

You own delivery: what the teams ship and how reliably they ship it. You develop and lead the engineers who report to you.

The role suits a senior software engineer with proven team leadership experience, or an experienced team lead ready to take on broader scope and formal people management. Your scope varies with the work: a single larger team, a team owning a technically demanding or unfamiliar area, or multiple teams building one product.

Strong software engineering fundamentals, proven software delivery leadership, and the ability to develop the engineers around you are all required. Domain knowledge is valuable but not required at hire.

title: Senior Sales Commission Analyst

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help improve the systems, processes, and resources that support successful customer implementations.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com .

About the Role

As a Senior Sales Commission Analyst you will support the administration, analysis, and continuous improvement of our global sales compensation programs. This role will partner closely with Sales, Finance, People Operations, Revenue Operations, and other cross-functional teams to ensure commissions are calculated accurately, paid on time, and aligned with business objectives. 

You will help manage the full commission lifecycle-from plan setup and quota assignments through calculation, validation, reporting, and issue resolution. This position requires someone who is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with complex data, compensation plans, and commission systems.

Responsibilities

• Administer monthly and quarterly sales commission and Variable Compensation Target (VCT) processes for a global sales organization, ensuring accurate and timely calculations and payments.

• Create, maintain, and administer incentive compensation plans, including quotas, crediting rules, accelerators, SPIFFs, bonuses, and other plan components.

title: Product Engineer, DaaS
description:
ABOUT US

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more.

We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for a Product Engineer to join our Data as a Service team in San Francisco.

LLMs happened because internet scale text already existed. Robotics has no internet to scrape. Nobody has labelled the physical world at scale, and every robot, AV, and surgical system on earth is stuck on exactly that. Surgical teams need thousands of labelled procedures. AV teams are sitting on 100,000 hours of footage they can't use.

Our Data as a Service team exists to unstick all of it. Customers hand us robotics video, LiDAR, medical imaging. We hand back labels. Sounds simple. It isn't: an ML layer routing work between models and expert humans, quality that's measured rather than vibes, one platform serving AI labs on one side and a global annotation workforce on the other.

The teams work is largely greenfield. There's no legacy system to work around and no playbook to follow, because nobody has built this before. What you ship becomes the foundation. The last wave of AI was built on internet data; the next one will be built on data from the physical world, and this team is building the machine that produces it.

WHAT TO EXPECT

- No ticket queue, no PM between you and the user: Product engineering here means the real version. You talk to the customer, figure out what matters, make the product call, ship it, and own the outcome: the win and the blast radius.

- Genuinely unsolved problems: Design the workflow where human reviewers and AI models hand work back and forth thousands of times an hour, and it feels seamless to the customer. Build one product that flexes across robotics, AV, and healthcare without turning into three products.

- End-to-end ownership: From product, design, and architectural decisions, all the way to deployment, monitoring, and measuring impact on users.

- Autonomy and collaboration: You will often work autonomously to take charge of your projects and drive your work forward. But as a lean and high trust team, we remain quick to collaborate and support each other with challenging problems together.

ABOUT YOU

- Are a builder: You know the difference between having a job and building something. You've founded something, been engineer #1, or been the engineer PMs quietly route the ambiguous stuff to.

- Are experienced: You've personally built and maintained systems from scratch, and you know what trade-offs are involved in shipping reliable, performant software at speed.

- Want customers in the room: Discovery calls, feedback, iteration: you'd rather hear it first-hand than read it in a ticket.

- Are a team player: You raise the people around you. You contribute your best work and help others contribute theirs.

WHY ENCORD

- Base salary, quarterly commission, and equity

- Significant ownership and growth as Encord scales

- Direct partnership with senior leaders on critical hiring priorities

- 4 days/week in our San Francisco (FiDi) office

- Flexible PTO + 18 paid vacation days and federal holidays

- Annual learning & development budget

- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

- U.S. and international travel opportunities

- Bi-annual offsites, twice-weekly team lunches, and monthly socials

title: Business Development Manager
description:
FinSet connects high-risk merchants with the payment and banking infrastructure they often struggle to access on their own. We work with prop trading firms, forex and CFD brokers, iGaming operators, and other high-risk businesses, matching them with the right acquirers, PSPs, and banking partners, and handling the operational work behind onboarding, compliance, corporate structuring, and licensing. We're not introducers who make an introduction and step away. We're hands-on operators who stay involved from the first conversation through onboarding and live processing.
We're hiring a Senior Business Development Manager to turn qualified opportunities into signed, live merchants. You'll take over from our SDRs once a lead is qualified, run the commercial conversation from discovery to close, and build long-term relationships with our merchants and with the referral partners who send business our way. This is a fully remote role, with a preference for candidates based in Dubai.
Tasks

• Competitive base salary plus commission on the deals you close

• Fully remote, with a preference for Dubai

• Work directly with the partners, with real influence over how we sell and grow

• Our SDRs bring qualified meetings to you, so your time goes into closing

• A full service offering to sell - payments, banking, licensing, and entity setup - giving you more ways to win and grow each account

Team

Working in close collaboration with the Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO), the team plays a key role in safeguarding the organization against financial crime risks. • Bachelor's degree in pharmacy, nursing, or related discipline; advanced degree preferred
